paper_title: First results of the CERN Resonant WISP Search (CROWS)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter chi, dimensionless, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of FIG. 14
notes: CROWS microwave light-shining-through-wall experiment at CERN. Paper reports two new exclusion limits: hidden sector photon (dark photon) kinetic mixing chi = 4.1e-9 at m = 10.8 ueV (Sept 2013 run, previously unexplored parameter space) and ALP photon coupling g = 4.5e-8 GeV^-1 at m_a = 7.2 ueV (June 2013 run in 3 T magnet; wideband limit g = 9.9e-8 GeV^-1). Following the pre-analysis hint, the DarkPhoton (HSP) result is extracted as the primary limit since it probes new parameter space; the ALP limit is not competitive with CAST. Full exclusion curves are only shown in Figs. 13-14 without tabulated data, so only the most-sensitive point quoted in the text/abstract is extracted. LSW experiment: no dark matter density assumption.
